description: Schema, database, document, user and dev-server tools for a Rebase backend project.
name: io.github.rebasepro/rebase

environmentVariables.description: Project root — the directory holding rebase.json. Defaults to the working directory.
environmentVariables.name: REBASE_PROJECT_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Backend URL, used when no local dev server is discovered.
environmentVariables.name: REBASE_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: API token for the target project. Not needed against a local dev server.
environmentVariables.name: REBASE_API_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Allow destructive tools to run against a non-local target. Off by default.
environmentVariables.name: REBASE_MCP_ALLOW_REMOTE_WRITES

title: Rebase
